content.query:
STEPS:

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
select DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,CustomerAccountId, count(1) 
FROM bnkm.repaymentplanpayment GROUP BY  DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,CustomerAccountId 
having count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,CustomerAccountId ORDER BY CustomerAccountId DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
* INTO Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment_WITH_DUP_20230622  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment_WITH_DUP_20230622
--8834257

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment
--8834257


--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
 [AssociationId]
,[FeeType]
,[AccruedDemandAmount]
,[TotalInstallmentAdjustedtAmount]
,[TotalRefundAmount]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CrystallisedAmount]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[DemandIndicator]
,[LateFeeStatusIndicator]
,[EquatedInstallmentAmount]
,[DemandAmount]
,[DemandOverdueDate]
,[DemandEffectiveDate]
,[LoanDemandFrequencyTypeId]
,[DeletedIndicator]
,[DemandSerialNumber]
,[DemandDate]
,[DemandFLowId]
,[ScheduleNumber]
,[CustomerAccountId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[TaskRunId]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[InsertDttm]

FROM Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment_WITH_DUP_20230622 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
select DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,CustomerAccountId, count(1) 
FROM bnkm.repaymentplanpayment GROUP BY  DemandSerialNumber,DemandDate,DemandFLowId,ScheduleNumber,CustomerAccountId 
having count(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment_WITH_DUP_20230622
--8834257


SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Bnkm.repaymentplanpayment
--8834257
